name: Cursed Carnival
source:
Lights up at the Bloodmoon Circus! Here, monsters take center stage, and every smile hides a secret. Will your story be a romance… or a tragedy?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
血月马戏团华灯初上！在这里，怪物们登台占据聚光灯中心，每一抹微笑背后都暗藏着秘密。属于你的故事，终将谱写成一段浪漫恋曲……还是一出悲剧？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
